description.value: The Aldergrove Community Archives & Telephone Museum is operated by the Alder Grove Heritage Society, a registered non-profit charity since 1990 dedicated to preserving the history of the Aldergrove region through artifacts, archives, and heritage buildings. The society runs an active digitization programme—including a full run of the local Aldergrove Star newspaper on microfilm—and hosts annual Community Heritage Days. Admission is by donation, making it a low-barrier cultural stop for cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at aldergroveheritage.ca confirms the address (3190 271 Street, Aldergrove BC V4W 3H7) and phone (604.857.0555), both matching OSM values. The site is clearly active with articles dated through May 2026, corroborating that the business is open. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cycling-specific amenities appears in the fetched website content or OSM tags, so all amenity fields are null; the OSM name includes 'Telephone Museum' but the website refers to the venue as 'Aldergrove Community Museum & Archives', a discrepancy worth flagging.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the name as 'Aldergrove Community Archives & Telephone Museum', but the website consistently refers to the venue as 'Aldergrove Community Museum & Archives' (e.g., Community Heritage Day announcement). The 'Telephone Museum' designation in the OSM name is not reflected anywhere on the website.
No cyclist amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags; all required criteria are unverifiable.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The museum is a legitimate community attraction and a plausible cycling destination in Aldergrove, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, water, washrooms) could be confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct contact is needed to determine whether it meets the minimum threshold for inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: Group tours can be arranged by email per the website. Admission is by donation.

wow_evidence: Heritage society archives plus a telephone museum — quirky small-museum stop.
blurb: Local archives with a telephone museum run by the heritage society.
